title: Implement the bounded HTTP fetcher and redirect handling
summary: Implemented an approved-destination-only HTTP/1.1 GET/HEAD transport with mandatory TLS verification; bounded connect, TLS, header, body and total deadlines; fixed-size streaming and SHA-256 hashing; identity/gzip/deflate decoding under compressed, decoded and ratio caps; manual redirect revalidation with hop provenance; safe transient retries, cancellation, normalized metadata/outcomes, honest crawler identity and redacted telemetry. Added hostile HTTP/TLS fixtures, architecture enforcement, CI coverage and synchronized operator/security documentation.
